Rae (Sales): heads-up: Nimbus Corp signed LOI, wants a 5-day POC. Key asks: steady 2k rps, p95 < 200ms, private VPC + KMS. Pricing ops: they prefer predictability but hate large upfront reserves.

Noah (Solutions): quick profiling Q: are those 2k rps mostly short chat requests or mixed embeddings? Even small embedding spikes change sizing.

Rae (Sales): they said ~80% chat (25-60 tokens), 20% embedding spikes ~256 tokens. Will drop CSV in deal room.

Priya (Eng): ballpark capacity: baseline 2 x A10-like pods for chat, autoscale to 3-4 for spikes. Embeddings should be routed to a separate pool to avoid blocking. Recommend KV prefix warming before cutover.

Carlos (SRE): preheat plan: 10m seed at 60% traffic then 15m ramp to 90% with KV cache warm calls. Add monitors: p95 latency, queue depth, error-rate. Pin reserved pods across 2 AZs.

Noah (Solutions): pricing suggestion: hybrid offer = reserve baseline for cost predictability + monthly burst credits for 2x replicas during business hours. Add an overage cap and hourly reporting. Safer than full-reserve.

Priya (Eng): routing fallback policy: reserved_pool -> quantized_variant_pool -> hosted_fallback. We'll provide perf deltas for quantized variant (p50/p95). Document will include scale triggers and max replicas to avoid runaway.

Rae (Sales): security note: they require SOC2 and HSM KMS. Carlos — any perf impact?

Carlos (SRE): SOC2 doc in vault. HSM KMS supported in Private; signing adds ~8-20ms per request depending on concurrency. We'll call that out in SLO appendix.

Noah (Solutions): action items: Rae upload CSV + questionnaire (EOD), Priya prepare autoscale JSON and routing doc (24h), Carlos draft preheat runbook + KMS note (24h). Schedule POC smoke Mon 09:00 PT.

ops-bot: scheduled: preheat-runbook-v2 -> staging at 2026-04-02T16:00:00Z

Priya (Eng): I'll validate perf numbers for quantized model and share p50/p95 by EOD.

Carlos (SRE): I'll own warmup script and rollback steps if p95 > 500ms.

Rae (Sales): thanks team. Keep updates in thread. :thumbsup:
